chunks: Al-‘Abbās, from ‘Abd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Ibn Muskān, from Mālik, the mawlā of al-Ḥakam, from Abī ‘Abd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the salat over the deceased escapes you until he is buried, then there is no harm in praying over him after he has been buried.

key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.صَلَاةٌ: salat; here, the funeral prayer offered for the deceased
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can salat over the deceased be performed after burial if it was missed before the burial?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat over the deceased. It states that if one misses the funeral prayer before burial, it is still permissible to perform the prayer after the deceased has been buried.
